thread:
Maya K: quick nightwatch handoff — I'm primary until 08:00 UTC, Aj P is secondary. Heads up: we started seeing a rising 5xx rate on embeddings-ingest in eu-west around 23:30 UTC, ~10% error spike. Not customer-facing yet but trending. :eyes:

Aj P: ack. I'll shadow alerts and prep rollback if needed. who's on EU infra for midnight window?

IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT embeddings-ingest (eu-west) — 5xx rate 10% over last 3m. Link: https://monitoring.redwood.ai/alerts/12345 — severity: S2 — runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/embeddings-ingest

Maya K: thanks bot. Quick notes for whoever picks this up:
- Triage criteria: if 5xx >= 5% sustained for 5m OR customer errors reported (support ticket) -> escalate to oncall-sre and page primary.
- If latency > 500ms p95 for more than 10m -> same escalation.
- For full outage (>=50% traffic failing) -> immediate P1 page 

Aj P: copying triage matrix here so it's easy to follow: 
```
severity = {
  "S1": ">=50% failing OR major customer outage -> page oncall-sre + eng-lead",
  "S2": ">=5% failing for >5m OR multiple tickets -> page oncall-sre",
  "S3": "transient spike <5m, no tickets -> monitor + notify secondary"
}
```

Liam T: I'm available as EU infra backup 00:30-04:00 UTC. If we need a console push or PV remount I can take it.

Maya K: perfect — add Liam as escalation fallback. Also note: Carlos M is on PTO starting 06:00 UTC, so we have a coverage gap 06:00-10:00 if shift extends. Nadia S, can you confirm manager escalation path if both primary and secondary are unresponsive?

Nadia S: yes — if both primary and secondary fail to acknowledge pager in 5m -> page @oncall-lead (pager group) and then ping me + eng managers. Escalation command we use: `/page oncall-lead "Unacked S2/S1 - embeddings-ingest eu-west"` then create an incident channel.

Sophia R: adding a couple quick runbook pointers — first step: check the ingestion consumer group lag and pod restarts. Useful commands: 
```
# check pods
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=embeddings-ingest

# tail logs
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=embeddings-ingest --tail=200 | grep ERROR

# consumer lag
curl -s http://kafka-metrics:9000/consumer-lag?group=embed-ingest | jq .
```

Carlos M: fwiw, last deploy touched the ingest-retry logic. If we see a rising retry loop count, revert to `embed-ingest@2024-11-12` (stable). Revert pipeline: `deploy rollback embed-ingest --to 2024-11-12` (requires approver from eng-lead).

Aj P: current action items —
1) Maya: monitor alerts and post updates every 10m if trend persists.
2) Aj: if >5% for 5m, page oncall-sre and escalate to Nadia if unacked 5m.
3) Liam: stand by for infra ops 00:30-04:00 UTC.
4) Sophia: prepare logs + metrics snapshot for postmortem.

Maya K: update — spike held at ~10% for 4m now, no customer tickets yet. I'm spinning up an extra ingest replica to see if that smooths things (scaling x1 -> x2). Will post results. :thumbsup:

IncidentBot: NOTE: auto-scaling event — embeddings-ingest scaled from 2 -> 3 replicas by maya_k (autoscaler). Metrics: cpu 75% -> 60%.

Maya K: scaling helped p95 latency down from 620ms -> 420ms, 5xx back to ~3% over last 2m. Leaving monitoring on. If it drops below 5% and stays for 15m, we'll close the thread and mark resolved.

Aj P: good call. If it resurges, follow triage matrix and page as discussed. Thanks all. :wave:

Maya K: closing notes for whoever inherits — check support queue for any tickets from EU customers in the next hour; cc me if you escalate. I'll hand off formally at 08:00 UTC.
